name: motif_add_affix_process
description:
Author an affix process. Research first: motif_guide topic workflow or conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Use only if the affix infixes, reduplicates or rewrites the stem; otherwise author a plain affix with compose-author-lexical-entry. Regular assimilation at a boundary is a phonological rule (guide nasal-assimilation). Stages a new affix entry whose ordered input pattern matches phonemes, a natural class or the remaining stem, and whose output copies named parts, inserts phonemes, inserts a segment of a natural class, or copies a part with the features of a feature class laid over it: an infix, a partial or full reduplication, or a substitution that deletes matched input by omitting it from the output (Cebuano paN- before p/b gives m). It refuses an output that copies nothing or drops the remaining stem. Dry Run and Trial before a person Applies the Proposal.
Command: compose-author-affix-process. Agent class: Draft.

morph_type.description: Id of an affix morph type such as prefix, suffix or infix.

analysis_ws.description: Analysis writing system tag for the gloss and definition.

form.description: Optional headword shown for the entry, in the vernacular writing system form_ws, without the hyphens FieldWorks shows on affixes (for example in for the infix -in-). Give it with form_ws.

form_ws.description: Vernacular writing system tag for form.

msa.description: Affix grammatical info: kind inflectional, derivational or unclassified, its category, and for derivational toCategory, for inflectional slots.

input.description: Ordered pattern parts, each with a name and one of phoneme, naturalClass or remaining true; the remaining-stem part is last.

output.description: Ordered realization, each item exactly one of: copy of a named input part; insert of phoneme ids; insertClass, the id of a natural class one of whose segments is inserted (a class of several segments leaves the choice of member to the parser); modify, the name of an input part (a phoneme, a natural class or the remaining stem), with features, the id of a feature natural class laid over the copied part. An input part left out of the output is deleted.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
